nf2587a1ac7c.s: Debt Recovery Tribunals were set up under:
o: Recovery of Debts Due to Banks and Financial Institutions Act, 1993
nf2587a1ac7c.x: DRTs were established under the Recovery of Debts Due to Banks and Financial Institutions Act, 1993; they are also used under SARFAESI.

n0431a442939.s: The SARFAESI Act, 2002 was based on the recommendations of the:
n0431a442939.x: The SARFAESI Act, 2002 was based on the recommendations of the Narasimham Committee.

ne1338b7da2a.s:
Consider the following about Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs):
1. They acquire NPAs, generally at a discount.
2. They are regulated by SEBI.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ne1338b7da2a.x: ARCs acquire NPAs, generally at a discount, and are regulated by the RBI, not SEBI.

n55114d91433.s: Under the IBC waterfall mechanism, which of the following ranks above government dues?
n55114d91433.x: Resolution costs, workmen's dues and secured creditors' claims are placed above government dues in the IBC waterfall.

nfe855bca205.s:
Consider the following about the RBI's Prudential Framework for Resolution of Stressed Assets:
1. Lenders must review the borrower account within 30 days of default.
2. Signing an Inter-Creditor Agreement is voluntary.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nfe855bca205.x: The framework requires a 30-day review after default and makes the Inter-Creditor Agreement mandatory, with resolution envisaged within 180 days.

n2beba729f8a.s: The deterrent effect of the IBC is shown mainly by:
o: Completion of all cases by NCLT within 330 days
Settlement of a large number of cases before admission
Transfer of all recovery cases to Lok Adalats
n2beba729f8a.x: The settlement of 30,310 cases worth ₹13.78 lakh crore before admission was cited as evidence of the IBC's deterrent effect.

n58b2316b07b.s: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) regulates:
n58b2316b07b.x: IBBI regulates insolvency professionals, insolvency professional agencies, information utilities and registered valuers.

n24569ff3e17.s:
Which of the following are cited as reasons for the decline in banks' NPAs?
1. The 4R strategy and higher provisioning
2. The IBC and NARCL
3. Lower provisioning requirements
n24569ff3e17.x: The decline in NPAs is attributed to the 4R strategy, higher (not lower) provisioning, the IBC and NARCL.

neae54b9e331.s: Which of the following pairs of PCA trigger parameter and indicator is INCORRECTLY matched?
neae54b9e331.x: Asset quality is assessed through the net NPA ratio; the Tier-1 leverage ratio measures leverage.

nc846baf4a9d.s: MUDRA Ltd, which refinances lenders under PMMY, is a subsidiary of:
nc846baf4a9d.x: MUDRA Ltd was set up as a subsidiary of SIDBI on 18 March 2015 to undertake refinance functions.

ne832b8d5ece.s:
Consider the following about DAY-NRLM:
1. It is run by the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. It was launched in 2011.
3. It mainly targets urban enterprises.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ne832b8d5ece.x: DAY-NRLM is a Ministry of Rural Development programme launched in 2011 to promote rural livelihoods through SHGs, not urban enterprises.

nc5b43d0aeba.s:
Consider the following about SHG-bank linkage in Andhra Pradesh:
1. AP ranks first in the country, with about 36% of the national share.
2. AP's SHG model is run directly by NABARD without any State society.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc5b43d0aeba.x: AP ranks 1st with a 36% national share and about 99.66% recovery; its model is run by SERP, not directly by NABARD.

n4d543bc2250.s: Promotion of digital payments was shifted from MeitY to which department of the Ministry of Finance?
n4d543bc2250.x: Responsibility for promoting digital payments moved from MeitY to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance.

nc8ac8cd83bd.s:
Consider the following about UPI:
1. It was launched in April 2016 with 21 banks.
2. It operates on the NEFT framework.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc8ac8cd83bd.x: UPI was launched in April 2016 with 21 banks and operates on the IMPS framework, not NEFT.

n37999203af1.s:
Consider the following:
1. The e-rupee is money itself and a liability of the RBI.
2. UPI is money issued by the RBI.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n37999203af1.x: The e-rupee is an RBI liability; UPI is only a payment system that moves bank-account money.

nindian-economy-17-2.s:
Consider the following about NPCI:
1. It was incorporated in December 2008 as a not-for-profit company.
2. It was incorporated as a Section 8 company under the Companies Act, 1956.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-17-2.x: NPCI was set up in December 2008 as a not-for-profit Section 25 company under the 1956 Act; Section 8 is the matching provision of the 2013 Act.

nindian-economy-17-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-economy-17-6.x: Bharat BillPay is an interoperable bill-payment system; NACH handles bulk recurring payments, BHIM is a UPI app and the RBI is the regulator.

n309b39007f0.s:
Consider the following about payments in India:
1. More than 90% of UPI users still use cash.
2. UPI has completely replaced cash for most of its users.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n309b39007f0.x: Over 90% of UPI users still use cash, so payment behaviour remains hybrid rather than fully digital.

n7eb59698902.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Call money – overnight inter-bank funds
2. Notice money – 2 to 14 days
3. TREPS – tri-party repo arrangement
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n7eb59698902.x: All three are correct: call money is overnight, notice money runs 2 to 14 days, and TREPS is a tri-party repo.

nindian-economy-61-6.s:
Consider the following about Government dated securities:
1. They have a maturity of at least one year.
2. They are issued only by State Governments.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-61-6.x: Dated securities are long-term (one year or more) and issued by the Central Government; States issue State Development Loans.

n471d21fe564.s:
Consider the following:
1. REITs pool real-estate assets.
2. InvITs pool real-estate assets.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n471d21fe564.x: REITs pool real-estate assets, while InvITs pool infrastructure assets.

nindian-economy-60-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Maturity – Nominal value of the bond
Coupon – Date when principal is repaid
nindian-economy-60-13.x: A bondholder is a lender (creditor) to the issuer; maturity is the repayment date, face value the nominal value and coupon the interest.

nindian-economy-3-2.s:
Consider the following:
1. Jim O'Neill coined the term BRIC in 2001.
2. The first BRIC Summit was held in 2008.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-3-2.x: O'Neill coined 'BRIC' in 2001; the first BRIC summit was held in 2009 at Yekaterinburg, not 2008.

nindian-economy-10-9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Secondary market – Company sells to investor
Primary market – Company sells to investor
nindian-economy-10-9.x: In the primary market a company sells new securities to investors; in the secondary market investors trade with each other on exchanges.

nf8d67ce9bda.s: In an IPO, the proceeds of an offer for sale go to the:
nf8d67ce9bda.x: In an offer for sale existing owners sell their holdings and receive the proceeds; only a fresh issue brings money to the firm.

n3736d203e95.s:
Consider the following about the BSE:
1. It was first recognised under the SCRA on 31 August 1957.
2. It was established in 1992 by financial institutions.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n3736d203e95.x: BSE was recognised under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act on 31 August 1957; it was formally set up in 1875.

nindian-economy-56-6.s:
Consider the following about the SENSEX:
1. It tracks the movement of 30 selected companies.
2. It represents the movement of all shares listed on the BSE.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-56-6.x: SENSEX tracks 30 selected large companies on the BSE, not all BSE shares.

n64ec2785881.s: Which committees are associated with the development of India's futures and options market?
o: L.C. Gupta and J.R. Varma Committees
n64ec2785881.x: The L.C. Gupta Committee (1998) and the J.R. Varma Committee (2002) shaped India's F&O market.

n73da6a2b0f3.s:
Consider the following about India's options market:
1. It is among the world's largest by number of contracts.
2. SEBI found that nine out of ten option traders lost money.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n73da6a2b0f3.x: India's options market is among the largest by contracts, and SEBI found nine out of ten option traders lost money.

nindian-economy-11-2.s:
Consider the following about the Forward Markets Commission (FMC):
1. Set up in 1953, it regulated commodity futures markets.
2. It merged with SEBI in 2014.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-11-2.x: The FMC (1953) regulated commodity futures and merged with SEBI in 2015, not 2014.

na0d92b86fce.s:
Consider the following about the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT):
1. It hears appeals against SEBI and stock exchanges.
2. Appeals from SAT lie to the RBI.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na0d92b86fce.x: SAT hears appeals against SEBI and exchanges; a further appeal lies to the Supreme Court, not the RBI.

nindian-economy-11-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Non-UTI public-sector mutual funds set up – 1993
Non-UTI public-sector mutual funds set up – 1996
nindian-economy-11-6.x: SEBI's first Mutual Funds Regulations came in 1993; non-UTI public-sector funds came in 1987 and the revised regulations in 1996.

nindian-economy-10-2.s:
Consider the following about SEBI:
1. Its parent law is the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956.
2. It began in 1988 as a non-statutory body.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-10-2.x: SEBI began in 1988 as a non-statutory body; its parent law is the SEBI Act, 1992, not the SCRA.

nf7ccf01e246.s:
Consider the following about the PMC Bank failure:
1. The bank had hidden exposure to one realty group.
2. Dual control by the RBI and State Registrars weakened its oversight.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf7ccf01e246.x: PMC Bank hid its exposure to one realty group, and dual control by the RBI and State Registrars weakened oversight.

n06f00d808d2.s:
Consider the following:
1. RBI-designated D-SIBs include SBI, ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank.
2. These D-SIBs must hold an additional CET1 surcharge.
3. Some Indian banks are included among the FSB's G-SIBs.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n06f00d808d2.x: SBI, ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank are D-SIBs with an extra CET1 surcharge; no Indian bank is among the FSB-identified G-SIBs.

n030300a1168.s:
Consider the following:
1. Deflation is a fall in the general price level.
2. Disinflation means negative inflation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n030300a1168.x: Deflation is a fall in the price level (negative inflation); disinflation is a fall in the inflation rate that stays positive.

n6b02637ceb5.s:
Arrange the following types of inflation in ascending order of rate:
A. Walking inflation
B. Creeping inflation
C. Hyperinflation
D. Galloping inflation
n6b02637ceb5.x: Creeping inflation is below 3%, walking about 3-10%, and galloping inflation precedes hyperinflation in severity.

nindian-economy-51-1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Headline inflation – Excludes volatile food and fuel
Core inflation – Includes food and energy
nindian-economy-51-1.x: CPI tracks retail prices; headline inflation includes food and energy, core excludes them, and WPI tracks wholesale goods.

n322070bfcf9.s:
Consider the following about price indices and their uses:
1. CPI is used for revising dearness allowance.
2. WPI is used for contract escalation and industrial analysis.
3. The GDP deflator is used for industrial workers' dearness allowance.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n322070bfcf9.x: CPI is used for dearness allowance and WPI for contract escalation; industrial workers' DA uses CPI-IW, not the GDP deflator.

nindian-economy-51-2.s: Which of the following is INCORRECT?
o: CPI-IW is compiled by the NSO.
CPI-Combined is the RBI's inflation-target measure.
The NSO compiles CPI-Rural and CPI-Urban.
nindian-economy-51-2.x: CPI-IW is compiled by the Labour Bureau; the NSO compiles CPI-Rural, CPI-Urban and CPI-Combined.

n870bef3a112.s:
Consider the following:
1. WPI covers both goods and services.
2. CPI covers both goods and services.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n870bef3a112.x: CPI measures retail prices of goods and services; WPI measures first-point bulk prices of goods only.

ne903d47ff41.s: Who established an inverse relationship between unemployment and wage inflation in 1958?
ne903d47ff41.x: A.W. Phillips established the inverse relationship between unemployment and wage inflation (the Phillips curve) in 1958.

n2c0cd1b79fe.s:
Consider the following about inflation in Andhra Pradesh in May 2026:
1. AP's retail inflation (4.9%) was above India's (3.9%).
2. AP's rate had stayed above the national rate for five consecutive months.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n2c0cd1b79fe.x: AP recorded 4.9% retail inflation against India's 3.9% in May 2026 and stayed above the national rate for five months in a row.

n757478ba94f.s:
Consider the following:
1. Indirect taxes are generally non-inflationary.
2. Direct taxes are generally non-inflationary.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n757478ba94f.x: Direct taxes are generally non-inflationary, while indirect taxes raise prices because their burden is built into prices.

nindian-economy-44-2.s:
Consider the following:
1. The burden of GST can be shifted to another person, generally through prices.
2. The burden of property tax can be shifted through prices.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-44-2.x: GST is an indirect tax whose burden is passed on; property tax is a direct tax and cannot be shifted through prices.

n894b21c9ebb.s:
Consider the following about the tax on professions, trades and employments:
1. It is a State levy under Article 276.
2. It has no constitutional ceiling.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n894b21c9ebb.x: Profession tax is a State levy under Article 276, with a ceiling of ₹2,500 per year.

nindian-economy-44-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Income tax – Value added at each stage
Corporation tax – Company income or profit
VAT – Import or export of goods
nindian-economy-44-4.x: Corporation tax is levied on company profits; income tax is on income, customs on imports/exports and VAT on value added.

ne38d175b692.s:
Consider the following about India's tax revenue:
1. Indirect taxes dominated during the early planning decades.
2. Direct taxes dominate in the recent period.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ne38d175b692.x: Excise, customs and sales taxes dominated in the early planning decades, while direct taxes dominate now.

n1643b41e51e.s:
Consider the following about MAT under Budget 2026-27:
1. Its rate was reduced to 14% and it was made a final tax.
2. New MAT credit continues to be allowed after 1 April 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n1643b41e51e.x: Budget 2026-27 cut MAT to 14% and made it a final tax; no new MAT credit is allowed after 1 April 2026.

nabd4504247d.s: Which of the following pairs of tax and year of introduction is correctly matched?
nabd4504247d.x: STT came in 2004; wealth tax in 1957, gift tax in April 1958 and estate duty in 1953.

n35a8b958614.s: Expenditure tax was introduced in 1958, on Nicholas Kaldor's advice, by Finance Minister:
n35a8b958614.x: Finance Minister T.T. Krishnamachari introduced the expenditure tax in 1958 on Kaldor's advice.

n5472b8d965b.s:
Consider the following about Dividend Distribution Tax (DDT):
1. It was abolished with effect from 1 April 2020.
2. Dividends are now taxed in the hands of shareholders.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5472b8d965b.x: Budget 2020-21 abolished DDT from 1 April 2020, and dividends became taxable in shareholders' hands.

nc2e0af554d4.s:
Consider the following about OECD Pillar Two:
1. It applies to all companies regardless of size.
2. It provides for a 15% global minimum corporate tax.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc2e0af554d4.x: Pillar Two sets a 15% global minimum corporate tax for large multinational enterprises, not all companies.

n6f0618caa62.s:
Consider the following:
1. The Income-tax Act, 2025 replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961.
2. The replacement took effect from 1 April 2025.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n6f0618caa62.x: The Income-tax Act, 2025 replaced the 1961 Act with effect from 1 April 2026, not 2025.

n4e985c8f306.s: Which of the following pairs of GST body and chair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Empowered Committee of State Finance Ministers – Arvind Subramanian
Revenue Neutral Rate Committee – Arvind Subramanian
Empowered Committee of State Finance Ministers – Asim Dasgupta
n4e985c8f306.x: The Empowered Committee was chaired by Asim Dasgupta; Arvind Subramanian chaired the Revenue Neutral Rate Committee.

nbe534670f37.s:
Consider the following about GST:
1. It was recommended by the Vijay Kelkar Task Force and follows the Canadian dual model.
2. The GST concept was first used in Canada.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nbe534670f37.x: India's GST, first proposed under the Vajpayee government, followed the Kelkar Task Force and the Canadian dual model; the concept was first used in France.

n253758447af.s:
Consider the following about voting in the GST Council:
1. The Centre's vote has one-third weight and all States together two-thirds.
2. Decisions need a three-fourths majority of weighted votes of members present and voting.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n253758447af.x: Under Article 279A the Centre has one-third and the States two-thirds of votes cast, and decisions need a three-fourths weighted majority.

nindian-economy-15-2.s:
Consider the following about the GST Council:
1. It is chaired by the Union Minister of State for Finance.
2. It is a constitutional body under Article 279A.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-15-2.x: The GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A chaired by the Union Finance Minister; the MoS is only a member.

n126829524d0.s:
Consider the following about GST:
1. It is a multi-stage, destination-based consumption tax.
2. Its taxable event is manufacture.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n126829524d0.x: GST is a multi-stage, destination-based tax on value addition whose taxable event is supply, not manufacture.

n9945fbc076d.s: Which is the largest source of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue (2024-25 RE)?
n9945fbc076d.x: SGST is AP's largest own tax source at about Rs 36,296 crore (38%); State excise (22%) is second.

n65d94c9514e.s:
Consider the following about GST:
1. Exports and supplies to SEZs are zero-rated, with full ITC refund.
2. Nil-rated supplies allow input tax credit.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n65d94c9514e.x: Zero-rated supplies (exports, SEZ supplies) get full ITC refund; nil-rated supplies do not permit ITC.

n948629fc530.s:
Assertion (A): An Inverted Duty Structure can block the working capital of businesses.
Reason (R): Input tax credit accumulates when the tax paid on inputs is higher than the tax payable on output.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n948629fc530.x: Both are true, and the accumulation of ITC from higher input taxation directly explains the blocked working capital.

n107749f287a.s:
Consider the following about an inter-State supply under GST:
1. IGST is levied by the Centre and apportioned.
2. The State share of IGST goes to the producing State.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n107749f287a.x: IGST is levied by the Centre and apportioned; the destination (consuming) State receives the State share.

n9b782b8afd0.s:
Consider the following about Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue (2024-25 RE):
1. GST is the largest contributor, at about 38%.
2. State Excise is the second largest, at about 22%.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n9b782b8afd0.x: GST is the largest contributor at 38% (Rs 36,296 crore) and State Excise second at 22% (Rs 21,300 crore).

n5269e5be151.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 271 – Surcharge on certain Union taxes for the Union
Article 265 – Taxes without authority of law in emergencies
n5269e5be151.x: Article 271 provides surcharges wholly for the Union; Article 276 covers professional taxes, Article 293 State borrowing and Article 265 requires authority of law for taxation.

n8a1bb002c47.s:
Consider the following:
1. Article 292 deals with borrowing by the States.
2. Article 293 deals with borrowing by the States.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n8a1bb002c47.x: Article 292 deals with borrowing by the Union, while Article 293 deals with borrowing by the States.

n97314d574aa.s:
Consider the following about the Fourteenth Finance Commission:
1. It made tax devolution, rather than grants, the main route of transfers.
2. It ended the distinction between Plan and non-Plan expenditure.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n97314d574aa.x: The 14th FC shifted transfers from grants towards tax devolution and ended the Plan/non-Plan distinction.

n7248f601fd7.s:
Consider the following about the Sixteenth Finance Commission:
1. It recommended disaster grants of ₹1.55 lakh crore.
2. It added heatwaves and lightning as notified disasters.
3. It discontinued all disaster grants.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n7248f601fd7.x: The 16th FC recommended ₹1.55 lakh crore in disaster grants and a ₹2.04 lakh crore State corpus, and added heatwaves and lightning as notified disasters.

nindian-economy-50-3.s:
Consider the following about Finance Commissions:
1. The 11th Finance Commission, under A.M. Khusro, was constituted in 2002.
2. The 2nd Finance Commission, constituted in 1956, was chaired by K. Santhanam.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-50-3.x: The 2nd FC (1956) was chaired by K. Santhanam; the 11th FC under A.M. Khusro was set up in 1998, while 2002 was the 12th (C. Rangarajan).

n5eb25edd5e2.s:
Consider the following about Article 280(3):
1. Clause (b) concerns principles governing grants-in-aid under Article 275.
2. Clause (d) concerns any other matter referred to the Commission by the President.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5eb25edd5e2.x: Article 280(3)(b) covers grants-in-aid principles under Article 275, and clause (d) any other matter referred by the President.

nd80df9de443.s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, which pair of criterion and weight is correctly matched?
nd80df9de443.x: Population carried 60%, per capita income 25%, tax effort 7.5% and special problems 7.5%.

na578b881a6b.s:
Consider the following about the divisible pool of central taxes:
1. It excludes cesses and surcharges.
2. It was about 81% of gross tax revenue in 2025–26.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na578b881a6b.x: The divisible pool comprises shareable taxes under Article 270, excluding cesses and surcharges, and was about 81% of gross tax revenue in 2025–26.
